answers.q1_stepwise_equivalent: YES on tiny synthetic CPU batch=1 networks: fired, v, RNG state, steps and last_spike equal; official full brain untested.
answers.q2_real_pre_reset_and_contributions: YES in the instrumented step: v_start, leak, synaptic+gain, tonic, noise, eye, inject, pre-threshold and post-reset are recorded; not inferred.
answers.q3_logging_changes_state: NO in synthetic tests: logging on/off produced identical v/RNG/fired/state.
answers.q4_full_brain_risk: Small static log estimate: ~14.25 MiB for 415 core targets, ~34.33 MiB with 1000 relays, ~48.6 MiB with 1415; time overhead UNVALIDATED; no full-brain measurement.
answers.q5_ready_for_observation_experiment: Not yet automatically; use B-first model-semantics validation and a new explicit authorization. The prototype is ready for further synthetic validation, not official full-brain use.
